description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions, flat $0.002 a call: the same request and response as OpenAI's /v1/chat/completions (messages, model, max_tokens, temperature, response_format json_object, stream), so an OpenAI SDK works by changing the base URL. Models: llama-4-scout (default), gpt-oss-20b, qwen3-30b, glm-4.7-flash. Up to 10,000 characters in, 1,024 tokens out. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

max_tokens.description: Most tokens to generate (above 1,024 is capped)

model.description: Model (default llama-4-scout; other names run on the default)

stream.description: true answers as Server-Sent Events chunks

name: chat_completions
